title: Minimum Time To Complete Trips
description:
Each bus takes `time[i]` units to complete one trip and can immediately start another. Buses operate independently. Return the minimum time for all buses together to complete at least `totalTrips` trips.

## Examples

```text
Input: time = [1,2,3], totalTrips = 5
Output: 3
```

```text
Input: time = [2], totalTrips = 1
Output: 2
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= time.length <= 10^5`
- `1 <= time[i], totalTrips <= 10^7`
